name: name_vacElem_of_isEmpty
summary: On empty matrices Φ is the constant Φ(0) times the box indicator, and naming by the box indicator is the projection, which fixes the vacuum.

steps.lean: nth_rw 1 [(funext (by simp [eq_zero ·]) : Φ = Φ 0 • boxIndicator _ 𝔠.S)]

steps.claim: Naming by the box indicator is the projection to S (`Space.name_boxIndicator`), which fixes the vacuum.
